prompt: What is the title of the song that had the second highest record sales recorded on the Discography of American Historical Recordings in the same year that Fred J. Rath was elected mayor of Utica?
answer:
The song was **“My Blue Heaven.”**

Fred J. Rath was elected mayor of Utica in **1927** and began serving in 1928; in the Discography of American Historical Recordings’ listings for that period, **“My Blue Heaven”** had the second-highest recorded sales.
